name: Osemozotan
summary: Osemozotan is a selective 5-HT1A receptor agonist with some functional selectivity, acting as a full agonist at presynaptic and a partial agonist at postsynaptic 5-HT1A receptors. 5-HT1A receptor stimulation influences the release of various neurotransmitters including serotonin, dopamine, norepinephrine, and acetylcholine. 5-HT1A receptors are inhibitory G protein-coupled receptor.

pharmacology.text: Osemozotan acts as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor. It binds with almost 1,000 times greater affinity for the 5-HT1A receptor than for most other serotonin, dopamine, or adrenergic receptors. Even with repeated exposure of 5-HT1A receptors to osemozotan, there is no change in the number of receptors, unlike with other pharmaceutical agonists.

uses.text: It is used to investigate the role of 5-HT1A receptors in modulating the release of dopamine and serotonin in the brain and their involvement in addiction to stimulants such as cocaine and methamphetamine.

summaryZh: 奧莫佐坦（英語：Osemozotan，研發代號：MKC-242）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C19H21NO5，能用作5-HT1A受體激動劑。
summaryZhHans: 奥莫佐坦（英语：Osemozotan，研发代号：MKC-242）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C19H21NO5，能用作5-HT1A受体激动剂。

fact.en: It is used in the laboratory to separate what the 5-HT1A receptor does before and after the synapse, because it acts as a full agonist at one and only a partial agonist at the other.
fact.zh: 它在實驗室中被用來區分 5-HT1A 受體在突觸前與突觸後的不同作用，因為它在其中一側是完全促效劑，在另一側只是部分促效劑。
fact.zhHans: 它在实验室中被用来区分 5-HT1A 受体在突触前与突触后的不同作用，因为它在其中一侧是完全促效剂，在另一侧只是部分促效剂。
